title: A course pack's choose-tool puzzle (courses/<id>/puzzles/<name>.json)
description: Pick the tool (or mode) that fits the job: the right one does it, a wrong one gets its reason. For first-words: the speaking tube or the hatch; for the Three Helms (Copilot app only): the session mode for each order. Every puzzle file has an `id`, its `mechanic`, and may set `disabled` (the site stays as scenery), `text` (its words by key, `{name}` filled in by the game) and `lines` (its voice line ids by what they're for). docs/specs/COURSE-PACKS.md §4.

quest.description: The quest the puzzle plays in (a quest of this course): the steps its mechanic sets and waits on (PUZZLE_STEPS, src/course/puzzles.ts) are that quest's.

steps.description: The mechanic's steps (PUZZLE_STEPS) that the quest calls something else: game step → the quest's step.

disabled.description: The course turns this puzzle off: its site stays as scenery and its cue does nothing.

text.description: The puzzle's words by key (labels, hints, readouts, signs).

lines.description: Voice line ids (voice/lines.json) by what they're for.

quiz.description: The quiz it asks first, if any.

scripts.description: Script steps it plays, by name (as in quests/<island>.json).

acts.description: The Three Helms: the game's helm this mode acts out (steer: you choose each leg; review: a chart to accept, take over or amend; auto: handed over end to end). Each helm is bound once.

modes.description: The Three Helms: the course's modes, keyed by its own ids (orders, their `wrong` and orderHints use the same keys).

acts.description: What the option does: accept (sail the chart), takeOver (hand the wheel back), amend (chart round the Shoal). Each once.
